Watch Chandragupta Maurya Episode - 79 now!
Synopsis :
Amatya Rakshas makes Chandragupta a slave and offers him to Patanraj. Moreover, he declares his intentions to him that Chandragupta should die in 'Hiranyagarv'. Chandragupta requests Patanraj and saves the lives of the former five Pipliwan soldiers. He is moved by the pathetic conditions of the soldiers. Meanwhile, Dhananand plans to gift to a sword to Chandragupta for his deeds. Later, Chandragupta learns about the 'Kaal Pakhi', whose presence is the epitome of death. He tries to stop a soldier from sacrificing his life in fire.
